description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific Git commit SHA, including author info, statistics, modified files, and selective unified file diffs. Use to inspect exact code changes made in a commit. Supports file_path filtering and line limits to prevent context exhaustion on large commits.

file_path.description: Filter diffs to only this specific file (prevents token blowout on large multi-file commits)

ignore_lockfiles.description: If true, automatically collapses diffs for lockfiles and minified assets (default: true)

max_diff_lines.description: Maximum lines of diff text to return per file (default: 500)

project_id.description: Project numeric ID (e.g. 31) or namespace path (e.g. 'group/project-name'). URL-encoding is handled automatically.

sha.description: Commit SHA or short commit hash to inspect

with_diff.description: If true, includes file diffs for the commit

name: get_commit
title: Get Commit Details & Diff
